purpose: Verify that lfm2-vl-1.6b can learn and execute a novel text-only fold/unfold command grammar while maintaining deterministic content retrieval and Merkle verification over a full PDF book in a bounded token window.

required: PDF file for coverage and content extraction
LM Studio local server at http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1

instruction_learning.target: learned_command_used: true in at least 80% of multi-turn questions
instruction_learning.failure: Model reverts to unlearned syntax or fails to parse commands

content_retrieval.target: 100% of unfolds must pass Merkle verification
content_retrieval.failure: Hash mismatch indicates corrupted or replaced content

answer_quality.target: at least 75% of answerable questions answered correctly
answer_quality.failure: Hallucination or misuse of unfold/group operations

token_efficiency.target: average under 500 tokens per turn including unfold overhead
token_efficiency.failure: Token cost exceeds working window efficiency
